arg.name: frame_id
arg.description: Frame used in header.frame_id

arg.name: dev
arg.description: the linux file descriptor location for the camera

arg.name: sensor_type
arg.description: Physical sensor array size. Boson_320 or Boson_640. The driver cross-checks this against the V4L2-negotiated width and refuses to start on a mismatch.

arg.name: frame_rate
arg.description: Frame rate of the camera. Only 9.0/30.0/60.0 supported.

arg.name: video_mode
arg.description: Camera image format. YUV: camera-side AGC (mono8/bgr8, low CPU). RAW16: raw 16-bit thermal counts (mono16, no camera processing). The visual topics only exist in this mode.

arg.name: zoom_enable
arg.description: Digital 2x upscale (320x256 -> 640x512) of the published image. Only available on Boson320 cameras.

arg.name: yuv_color
arg.description: In YUV mode, publishes image_raw as bgr8 instead of mono8. Use this if a color palette (e.g., Rainbow) is enabled via the FLIR GUI.

arg.name: agc_mode
arg.description: Content of the image_visual topic. none: no visual topic at all. fixed_range: stretch the temperature limits given by min_temp/max_temp. auto_range: stretch the percentiles given by agc_low_pct/agc_high_pct.

arg.name: agc_low_pct
arg.description: Bottom-tail clip percentage of the frame AGC (e.g. 1.0 discards the darkest 1% of pixels before linear stretch). Only honoured in agc_mode:=auto_range. Valid range [0, 50).

arg.name: agc_high_pct
arg.description: Top-tail clip percentage of the frame AGC (e.g. 1.0 discards the brightest 1% of pixels before linear stretch). Only honoured in agc_mode:=auto_range. Valid range [0, 50).

arg.name: agc_norm
arg.description: Renormalise image_visual to the observed frame bounds widened by agc_norm_margin, on top of whichever agc_mode produced the bounds.

arg.name: agc_norm_margin
arg.description: How much wider the observed bounds are taken when agc_norm is on, in grey levels of the active stretch.

arg.name: heatmap_mode
arg.description: Content of the image_heatmap topic. none: no heatmap topic. visual: colourise image_visual. Requires an agc_mode other than none.

arg.name: overlay_mode
arg.description: What is stamped on image_heatmap. none: nothing. min_max_ptr: the minimum, maximum and probe reading text and the probe marker, printed in the unit of temp_mode (in raw counts for a non-radiometric camera). Can be changed while the node runs.

arg.name: colormap
arg.description: Colour palette image_heatmap is painted with, e.g. jet, parula, viridis, inferno, hot, turbo. Only honoured when a heatmap is published.

arg.name: temp_mode
arg.description: Unit of the image_temp topic. none: no temperature topic. c, k, f: degrees Celsius, Kelvin and Fahrenheit as 32-bit floats. centi_c, centi_k, centi_f: the same units in hundredths as 16-bit integers. Only offered for radiometric cameras.

arg.name: radiometric
arg.description: Whether the camera can map the raw counts to absolute temperatures. auto: match the device identification against radiometric_patterns. true/false: override the detection.

arg.name: camera_info_url
arg.description: Camera calibration file URL (file:// or package://). Empty publishes uncalibrated CameraInfo.

arg.name: point_x
arg.description: X coord of the temperature probe point.

arg.name: point_y
arg.description: Y coord of the temperature probe point.

arg.name: min_temp
arg.description: Lower bound of the fixed_range stretch in degrees Celsius.

arg.name: max_temp
arg.description: Upper bound of the fixed_range stretch in degrees Celsius.
